{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Fat Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. As a large enemy, it has higher health and a slower speed compared to other duckies. The '''Fat Ducky''' can be spawned by [[Aged Eggroll 1]], [[Aged Eggroll 2]] and [[Aged Eggroll 3]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Made up of 99.99% of bread. We’re unsure about the last 0.01%''" ==Appearance== The '''Fat Ducky''' is an oversized yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak. Its body is significantly larger than most other duckies, and has a slightly smaller head. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Fat Ducky''' itself is quite weak, though it generally spawns in high numbers. **Area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]] are effective at clearing them out. **Single target DPS towers can also be useful here, such towers include the [[Cowboy]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Ace Pilot]]. *Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] can deal with it quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FatDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1FatDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1FatDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFatDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass -
